resources.string: Automatic checks
Off by default. Checks selected channels in the background when the battery is not low. Android may delay checks.
Selected channels
Remove channel from local upload alerts
Select channel for local upload alerts

Local alerts for new uploads from channels you select here. These selections are separate from YouTube’s bell settings and are shared across accounts on this device. The first successful check records existing videos without alerting. Android may delay background checks. Only uploads available in the public feed can be detected; this is not the YouTube notification inbox.
